findings.evidence: Accessible name is 'See an example review ↗' (dom name); screen readers announce 'north east arrow', which signals an external destination while the href is #example on the same page.
findings.after: See an example review (or wrap a glyph in )
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose and 3.2.4 Consistent Identification (external-link cue misused).

findings.where: focus ring on all three links
findings.evidence: Ring is outline 3px #8ba72a with 6px offset on the #f5f7f9 page: about 2.6:1 against the background it is drawn on, under the 3:1 non-text minimum (sweep measured 2.55:1 against the unfocused state). On the dark green primary button the 6px offset puts the ring on the page, so it is the page contrast that counts.
findings.after: outline: 3px solid #4f6418 (about 6:1 on #f5f7f9) or the brand green #244d42
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast and 2.4.7 Focus Visible.

findings.where: 'Back to the hero' link, end of page
findings.evidence: Label uses designer jargon ('the hero'); its target is #pp-title. It is also unstyled browser-default blue, unlike every other link, so it reads as broken styling.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose and 3.2.4 Consistent Identification.

findings.evidence: Sections have ids and h2s (#example-title, #workflow-title) but sweep found no <main>; the example's 'ILLUSTRATIVE CLIENT COMMENT' / 'ILLUSTRATIVE PROJECT STATUS' labels are <small> text, not headings or terms, so the comment and status are not tied to their labels.
findings.after:
around the sections, each
; the example as
Client comment
…
Project status
…

strengths: Smooth scrolling is gated behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
Single h1 then h2s in order; ordered list for the steps; primary action becomes full width under 380px.
Focus order follows the visual order (primary, How it works, Back to the hero) and no stop is covered.
Text contrast is high (#17232b on #f5f7f9; white on #244d42).
not_investigated: in-page jump focus behaviour (whether focus moves to #example): no live run
